review_runs.summary: Accurate, focused lesson with explained number–noun contrasts, answerable practice, and later contextual writing. Selected source has two minor weaknesses: unexplained gender labels and learner-facing commentary about instructional design. No endorsed non-Bokmål forms or valid alternatives incorrectly rejected were found. Reviewed all 13 exercises; all serve obj-cardinal-numbers-01. Number-word recall, quantity completion, and written messages practice expressing item counts. Noun sorting and one-form correction directly practice choosing en or ett by noun gender. Focused subskills remain aligned without testing every part of the objective.
